subtopics.title: Position, Distance, and Displacement
subtopics.description: Scalar path length versus vector displacement; origin and frame of reference dependence.

subtopics.title: Speed and Velocity
subtopics.description: Average versus instantaneous speed and velocity; vector direction; limits as dt approaches zero.

subtopics.title: Acceleration and Deceleration
subtopics.description: Rate of change of velocity; differentiation; deceleration as reduction in speed versus sign of acceleration.

subtopics.title: Kinematic Equations for Constant Acceleration
subtopics.description: Derivation and application of v = u + at, s = ut + 0.5 a t^2, v^2 = u^2 + 2 a s, and s_n = u + 0.5 a (2n - 1).

subtopics.title: Calculus-Based Kinematics for Variable Acceleration
subtopics.description: Integration and differentiation for a(t), a(x), and a(v); chain rule a = v dv/dx.

subtopics.title: Free Fall and Vertical Motion Under Gravity
subtopics.description: 1D motion with constant downward acceleration g; symmetry of time of ascent and descent; apex velocity.

subtopics.title: Graphical Analysis of Motion
subtopics.description: x-t, v-t, and a-t graphs; geometric interpretation of slope as derivative and area as integral.

subtopics.title: Ground-to-Ground Projectile Motion
subtopics.description: Orthogonal independence of horizontal and vertical motions; time of flight, maximum height, horizontal range, and trajectory parabola.

subtopics.title: Projection from an Elevated Platform or Tower
subtopics.description: Horizontal and angled launch from height h; time to hit ground; impact speed and angle.

subtopics.title: Projectile Motion on an Inclined Plane
subtopics.description: Tilted coordinate axes along and perpendicular to the incline; range up and down incline; maximum range condition.

subtopics.title: Trajectory Equation and Target Interception
subtopics.description: Solving for launch angle theta to hit given coordinate (x, y); envelope of safety parabola.

topics.title: Relative Motion in One and Two Dimensions

subtopics.title: Relative Velocity in One Dimension
subtopics.description: Definition v_AB = v_A - v_B; overtaking, head-on collisions, and reference frame transformations.

subtopics.title: Relative Motion in Two Dimensions
subtopics.description: Vector relative velocity v_AB = v_A - v_B in 2D; geometric pursuit and meeting conditions.

subtopics.title: River-Swimmer Problems
subtopics.description: Crossing a flowing river; condition for minimum time vs shortest path (zero drift).

subtopics.title: Rain-Umbrella Problems
subtopics.description: Apparent direction of falling rain seen by moving observer; umbrella tilt angle tan(phi) = v_man / v_rain.

subtopics.title: Closest Approach and Collision of Two Moving Bodies
subtopics.description: Relative position vector along relative velocity vector; minimum distance calculation and time to closest approach.

excluded_adjacent_topics.rationale: Forces, free body diagrams, friction coefficients, and F = ma belong strictly to Chapter 3 (laws-of-motion).
Kinetic energy theorem, potential energy, and mechanical work belong strictly to Chapter 4 (work-energy-power).
Centripetal and tangential forces, banking of roads, and conical pendulum belong to Chapter 5 (laws-of-motion / circular dynamics).
Lorentz transformations and relativistic addition of velocities are Olympiad extension topics.

primary_sources.role: Conceptual backbone, rigorous definitions, worked examples, exercise problems

primary_sources.title: Fundamentals of Physics (Halliday, Resnick & Walker)

primary_sources.role: Calculus formulations, instantaneous acceleration proofs, 2D vector kinematics

primary_sources.title: University Physics with Modern Physics (Young & Freedman)
primary_sources.coverage: Chapter 2: Motion Along a Straight Line (pp. 61-94) & Chapter 3: Motion in Two or Three Dimensions (pp. 95-130)
primary_sources.role: Vector trajectory proofs, component separation, graphical relationships

primary_sources.title: The Feynman Lectures on Physics, Vol. 1
primary_sources.role: Physical intuition on speed as rate of change, limits, time measurement

primary_sources.title: Problems in General Physics by I.E. Irodov
primary_sources.role: Advanced problem solving, river-swimmer frame shifts, trajectory curvature
